phases.label: Read Ticket
phases.prompt:
/read-ticket {{ticketId}}

After fetching the ticket, save the full summary to {{taskDir}}/{{ticketId}}.md. Create the directory if needed.

phases.label: Plan
phases.prompt:
/plan-ticket {{ticketId}}

The ticket content has already been fetched and saved to {{taskDir}}/{{ticketId}}.md. Do NOT fetch the ticket from Jira again — read it from that file instead. Save the planning document to {{taskDir}}/plan.md instead of .claude/planning/. Create the directory if needed.

phases.label: Implement
phases.prompt:
/implement-ticket {{ticketId}}

The planning document is at {{taskDir}}/plan.md. Read it from there instead of .claude/planning/. After implementation, save a summary of what was done to {{taskDir}}/implementation.md.

phases.label: Commit
phases.prompt:
/commit

After committing, save the commit hash and message to {{taskDir}}/commit.md.

phases.label: Create PR
phases.prompt:
/pr-creator

After creating the PR, save the PR URL and details to {{taskDir}}/pr.md. Create the directory if needed.

phases.label: Leave Comments
phases.prompt:
/pr-comments

After leaving comments, save a summary of the comments to {{taskDir}}/comments.md. Create the directory if needed.

phases.label: Generate Summary
phases.prompt:
/gen-summary {{ticketId}}

All artifacts are in {{taskDir}}/. Save the summary to {{taskDir}}/summary.md.
